reviewedChains.chain: OnPostAddAsync -> db.LibraryRoots.Add/SaveChanges -> root content assignments/routing; edit/delete/wake handlers share admin boundary
reviewedChains.scope: [Authorize Policy=JularrPolicies.AdminSystem], root/name/path/type validation; current error rollback retained
reviewedChains.evidence: Verified direct Razor mutation, never pure SELECT; provider/filesystem wake is Execute.

reviewedChains.chain: OnPostStartAsync -> provider PIN -> expired challenge delete/PlexLoginAttempts add/save -> poll/finish auth
reviewedChains.scope: Setup/owner presence; HTTPS or loopback, nonce hash and five-minute expiry; link requires current account/local password policy
reviewedChains.evidence: #920 Purpose delta: login/link preserved; AccountExternalLogins distinct from profile service connections; external I/O not inside SQL transaction.

reviewedChains.scope: Authenticated group, CurrentAccountContext.ProfileId; ClientVideoAccessFilter/appShell visibility; target existence checked
reviewedChains.evidence: VideoProgress.cs UpdateAsync:165 validates target and explicit completion; seek alone does not set completed. Legacy GUID resolution removed only with consumer switch.

reviewedChains.chain: GET watchlist -> PageRequest validation -> AppShell.GetMediaAccessAsync -> WatchlistStore.GetEffectivePageAsync -> WatchlistLibraryResolver
reviewedChains.scope: Current profile, visible media types, bounded page/pageSize; follow/ignore and franchise policy
reviewedChains.evidence: HttpJularrClientApi.kt:127 consumes totalCount/hasMore. Target read projects canonical Works/Profile; list query must not initiate NAS/provider work.

reviewedChains.chain: ExecuteAsync -> ProcessOnceAsync -> IWantedSource + IWantedRequestHandler dispatch -> AccessStore/OperationStore -> provider/download/import
reviewedChains.scope: IInstanceModuleService Acquisition/media capability upper bound; source/job cancellation/time budgets
reviewedChains.evidence: Program.cs:610-656 registers Anime/Movie/TV/Manga/LightNovel/Book/Music/Audiobook handlers; 631/635/686/694/780/784 sources. Source graph alone omits interface dispatch.

reviewedChains.chain: Startup scope -> DatabaseMigrationBridge.UpgradeAsync -> EF MigrateAsync -> WorkIdMigrationFollowUp.RunAsync
reviewedChains.scope: Startup internal caller, epoch 4/minimum 4; runs in existing installation, not executed by this audit
reviewedChains.targets: System.DatabaseInstallation.V1 -> installation Logic; one fresh baseline
reviewedChains.evidence: Old history and mapping are only inventory. Current bridge files remain until atomic cutoff, no old rows/history backfilled.

reviewedChains.chain: MoveStructureAsync -> RepointOrDropAsync<T> -> db.Set<T> -> per-Work unique key collision removal/repoint
reviewedChains.scope: sourceWorkId/targetWorkId; upstream merge authorization still to review
reviewedChains.evidence: Six concrete T: WorkSeason/Episode/Volume/Chapter/Edition/Version. WorkId reflection and EF.Property are actual dynamic column use, not an unknown seventh table.

reviewedChains.chain: Native PlaybackSessionClient -> HTTP/Hub -> PlaybackSessionStore dictionary -> state/command broadcasts
reviewedChains.scope: OwnerProfileId/revision; restricted short-lived pairing and participant-token access; revoke/end
reviewedChains.evidence: Store.cs:16 is in-memory. Distinct from SQL ActiveSessions. Native/Hub permissions and complete command paths still require final review.

reviewedChains.chain: start -> DevicePairingStore; authenticated approve -> profile; poll -> OwnerAuth.GetEnabledAccountAsync -> cookie sign-in
reviewedChains.scope: Start/poll anonymous rate limits, approve authenticated rate limit, single-use expiring device code
reviewedChains.targets: User.Accounts.V1 restricted pairing caller policy -> Logic.Accounts
reviewedChains.evidence: Pairing store deliberately in-memory. New Account != Profile: approving profile cannot substitute AccountId in target login.

reviewedChains.scope: Music capability and actor/source attribution; all individual auth callers not signed off
reviewedChains.evidence: Album WorkId is already PK/FK extension. Recording may appear on multiple albums; artist is not a competing Work root. Keep specialty responsibility, rebuild IDs/DDL fresh.

reviewedChains.chain: SubtitleLanguageProfileService.ResolveAsync -> ordered items/cutoff, specific media/root -> global default -> subtitle acquisition/completeness
reviewedChains.scope: Owner-managed language policy; Item.ProfileId is subtitle policy FK, not personal ProfileId
reviewedChains.evidence: Preserve forced/SDH/priority/cutoff and null-scope uniqueness. Technical streams do not replace cue content.

reviewedChains.chain: LoadAsync -> MigrateLegacyOwnerAccountUnsafe -> protected filesystem connection; Save/Disconnect/sync mode remain filesystem effects
reviewedChains.scope: Validated profile key, protected tokens; no values exported
reviewedChains.evidence: MigrateLegacyOwnerAccountUnsafe is not a PostgreSQL migration. Old profile filenames/provider assignments need approved rebinding or explicit reconnect in E; credential files are protected.
